awards.name: Scholastic Art & Writing Awards - Gold Key (Architecture)
AIA Regional High School Design Competition - Honorable Mention

rationale.intuition: Cornell AAP B.Arch 是 5-year professional degree program; admit rate ~10-13% ED 比 Cornell overall ~7-9% 略高 (program 数据 published as 'one of the most selective in Cornell colleges' but ED yields lift). 然而 B.Arch 评分 80% 取决于 portfolio 质量, engine 完全不识别 portfolio — 这是结构性 gap. Profile 本身 (3.92/1490 + Scholastic Gold + AIA honorable + 3yr studio) ED 估计 8-22%. Engine 用 majorMultiplier (Fine Arts band ~80% verySelective) 可能 over-estimate selectivity 因为 Architecture in CALS context 不同于 Fine Arts. 0.06 下界允许 engine 落在 program-multiplier-driven 低端; 0.25 上界反映 portfolio-strong + ED commitment 的真实 industry 区间.

sources.name: Cornell AAP Admissions FAQ 2024
sources.evidence: Cornell B.Arch admit rate historically 10-15% across cycles; 'portfolio is by far the most important factor — academic stats alone do not predict outcomes'

sources.name: Cornell University CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Cornell overall admit rate 7.5%; ED rate ~17%. AAP college-specific ED rates not published but inferred 12-15% from AAP class profile size

sources.name: Architectural Record - 'Getting Into Cornell Architecture' 2023
sources.evidence: B.Arch ED applicants with strong portfolios cluster 15-25% admit rate; without portfolio strength, falls to 3-8%

wontFix.reason: Engine does not model portfolio quality — Architecture/Art/Music programs heavily depend on portfolio/audition review which is unstructured. B.Arch's heavy portfolio weighting means same-stats applicants can vary 4-5× in real admit probability; engine treats them identically.
wontFix.followUp: Add portfolio quality signal to ProfileInput (essayQualityScore-style 0-10 from human counselor or future AI review). Until then, Architecture/Art/Music fixtures expose unmodeled variance.
